claims.exact_statement: For every nonconstant genuine Boolean f on a finite uniform cube that is restriction-critical, let S have Fourier spectral law, X_i=1_{i in S}, E_i=H(X_i|X_{-i}), J_i=Delta_i H-E_i, and Ddual(S)=H(S)-sum_i E_i. Then 0<=Ddual(S)<=sum_i J_i<=(2/ln 2)sum_i min(I_i(f),1-I_i(f))<=(2/ln 2)I(f).
hypotheses: restriction-critical: Delta_i H >= (H/I) I_i for every relevant coordinate
proof_dependencies: direct chain rule for Ddual nonnegativity
directly reproduced A003 split Delta_i H=E_i+J_i
claims.first_unproved_line: Control high-ratio critical-prime Boolean spectra when Ddual/H is arbitrarily small.

claims.exact_statement: For every fixed epsilon>0, every restriction-critical genuine Boolean f satisfying Ddual(S)>=epsilon H(S) obeys H(f)<=(2/(epsilon ln 2))I(f). Consequently every restriction-critical sequence with H/I tending to infinity has Ddual(S)/H(S)<=2/((H/I)ln 2) tending to zero.
hypotheses: fixed epsilon>0 for the restricted class endpoint
does_not_prove: a uniform lower bound on Ddual/H
claims.first_unproved_line: Prove a Booleanity or nonlocal-payment bound in the simultaneous critical-prime, exponentially diffuse, vanishing-Ddual/H regime.

claims.exact_statement: If FEI is false, there exists a genuine Boolean counterfamily h_k with H(h_k)/I(h_k) tending to infinity that is restriction-critical, tensor-prime, satisfies max_i I_i(h_k)<=e^3*2^(-H(h_k)/I(h_k)), and satisfies Ddual(S_k)/H(S_k)<=2/((H(h_k)/I(h_k))ln2) tending to zero.
claims.proof_source: REPORT.md Sections 2-4 and source-pinned A001 descent
claims.first_unproved_line: Exclude or bound the four-property residual class.
